question: Can the same fixed interface bind facts to FOUR same-class objects, with the two-object receiver configurations frozen and the sender adapted only in its object count?

receivers.rule: Qwen3-32B plus the highest-RESCREEN-J non-Qwen receiver (ties: GLM before Gemma), chosen before R3 outcomes
receivers.evidence_of_timing: the rescreen audit snapshot was committed at 2026-09-22T2132Z (90b23e3); the first R3 receiver audit was produced at 23:53Z (qwen3-32b only) and the non-Qwen R3 results after 00:10Z
receivers.note: this is a selected receiver, not an unselected receiver success rate

bank.semantics: four painted blocks; each has exactly one surface paint color and one constitutive material (permutations, so every queried value is unique); world 2 exchanges the colors of one pair; materials and the other two objects fixed; Q1 changed color, Q2 unchanged material with its target balanced over all four positions; every object position holds every value 48 times; aliases balanced over positions (8 per name per position); 0 skeletons and 0 aliases shared with any earlier bank
bank.pre_output_rebuild: one deterministic rebuild before any output: the first generator imbalanced the queried materials (80/48/48/16); rebuilt so queried colors and materials are exactly 48 each

sender.change_from_frozen: system text says four objects; user template lists four aliases and a four-key JSON shape; model, greedy decoding, max_new_tokens, inventory, parse rule, no-retry, equal q=255 and ordering imported unchanged from sender_candidate_a.py
sender.label: a declared four-object sender adaptation, not byte-identical reuse of the two-object prompt; one prompt, no search, no retries

receiver_side.configurations: frozen from R2: selected = raw fitted word-contrast write at relative depth 0.2 (qwen3-32b layer 13, gemma layer 12), gamma 1; original = the three-layer band; dictionaries unchanged; no refit, no position search on four-object material

layout.extension: the frozen renderer's object loop extended to four objects; identical to the frozen renderer for two objects (self-test)

receiver_side.parser: strict first-line match against the four predefined aliases (content_counterfactual.score_answer; mechanically unchanged)
receiver_side.fewshot_note: the receiver prompt keeps its frozen two-object few-shot demonstration

endpoints.primary: J = all four answers correct across both worlds, 64-token budget, 188 scenes (4 engineering scenes excluded), with four candidate aliases (chance J = 0.25^4 = 0.004)
secondary: sender extraction recall and object errors (post hoc, from the packets)

analysis.ci: cluster bootstrap over the 24 family cells and the 4 evidence templates, 20000 draws x seeds [190919,290919,390919]
analysis.multiplicity: none — no pre-declared test family or target for R4; every contrast is descriptive

not_pooled: a separate protocol and sample count; never pooled with R3
not_claims: no open-world or general relational reasoning claim
the same finite vocabulary and attribute operation as R3
stop_rule: if implementing the extension had required a scientifically different writer, R4 would stop and export the incompatibility; it did not (only the object loop changed)
